The Best Email Groups Service

The Best Email Groups Service

Serving online communities for over a decade

Groups.io is the ultimate group email service and modern listserv replacement for teams of any size. From small clubs of 10 to thriving communities of 100,000+, our email discussion list platform delivers messages directly to members' inboxes so they'll never miss a conversation. Unlike Google Groups or other alternatives, we offer photo sharing, file storage, calendar, wiki, chat, databases, and group analytics — all ad-free and privacy-focused. Our mailing list management solution scales effortlessly whether you're running a hobby group, nonprofit, or large organization.

Frequently Asked Questions

What features does Groups.io offer that other mailing list services don't?

Groups.io stands out with our comprehensive suite of integrated collaboration tools that go far beyond basic email lists. Unlike Google Groups or other services, we offer a full calendar system for scheduling events, a robust file storage area, a wiki for documentation, integrated chat rooms, photo galleries, and even customizable databases. Our moderation tools are significantly more powerful, allowing fine-grained control over permissions and content. We also provide unique features like integrated polls, message hashtags for organization, and the ability to mute specific conversation threads. Perhaps most importantly, Groups.io delivers all this while remaining completely ad-free and respecting your privacy—we don't mine your data or show advertisements like many competitors do.

How many members can I have in my Groups.io email list?

Groups.io scales effortlessly from small teams to massive communities. Our platform comfortably supports intimate groups of just 10 members all the way up to thriving communities with 100,000+ participants. There are no hard limits on group size with our paid plans. Free groups can have up to 100 members, while our Premium and Enterprise plans remove these limitations. Our infrastructure is designed for high-volume email delivery, ensuring reliable message distribution even for very large communities. Additionally, our moderation tools scale with your group size, providing the controls needed to manage communities of any size effectively.

Does Groups.io collect or sell my data? What's your privacy policy?

No, Groups.io does not sell your data to advertisers or third parties. Unlike Google Groups or Facebook Groups, we have a strict privacy-first approach—your conversations are not mined for advertising data or used to build marketing profiles. We only collect the information necessary to provide our service, and we don't track your activities across the web. Our business model is subscription-based rather than advertising-based, which allows us to prioritize user privacy. Your email addresses and group content remain private and are not shared. You can review our complete privacy policy to see exactly what data we collect and how we use it, but the short answer is: we respect your privacy and don't monetize your personal information.

Is Groups.io free to use? What are the pricing options?

Yes, Groups.io offers a Free plan that includes essential mailing list features for communities with up to 100 members. For growing groups, our Premium plan at $20/month (or $220/year) removes the member limit and adds advanced features like subgroups, file storage, a photos section, a calendar, polls, member directories, and more. You can see full details of our pricing here.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes, our Enterprise plan includes custom domain support. With this feature, your group's website address will appear under your own domain name, and all email communications will be sent from your domain rather than groups.io. Additionally, your organization's logo will be prominently displayed on the website, replacing the Groups.io branding. This provides a seamless branded experience for your members and maintains your organization's professional identity throughout all interactions. The custom domain feature requires minimal technical setup, and our support team can assist with the configuration process.

Can I charge membership dues for my group?

Yes. With Paid Memberships, Premium and Enterprise groups can create membership tiers with monthly or annual pricing and control which group features each tier can access. Members pay through Stripe Checkout using your group's own Stripe account, and the revenue goes directly to you. Paid Memberships is currently in early access and requires approval — contact support to request it for your group.

Ready to upgrade from your current listserv or Google Group?

Powerful Features, Better Security

Join over 6,000 groups that have successfully migrated to Groups.io. Our team will handle every step - from importing your members to preserving your complete message history. But that's just the beginning. Unlike other services, we offer a comprehensive suite of collaboration tools: an integrated calendar, real-time chat, photos and files sections, and a built-in wiki. For Premium groups, migration comes at no cost.

Contacting Groups.io Support

To reach the Groups.io team directly, use the support form. The form sends your account and group details along with your message, so we can start looking into it without having to ask which group and address you're writing about. You can also send an email message to support@groups.io.

Getting additional help

If you'd like more assistance or have questions, please check out the following groups:

  • Group_Help: This Groups.io group is open to anyone who has questions about groups.
    Note: This group is led by volunteers; it is not officially affiliated with Groups.io.
  • GroupManagersForum: This Groups.io group discusses members’ experiences as group owners and moderators, shares ideas for promoting and customizing group content areas, and offers techniques and advice for managing groups. In particular, the group’s wiki contains a wealth of information.
    Note: This group is led by volunteers; it is not officially affiliated with Groups.io.

Submitting suggestions for new features or improvements

If you have a suggestion for a new Groups.io feature or an improvement to the service, you can join the Groups.io Beta Group. This group discusses the Groups.io service and how it can be improved. Hashtags are required and new topics are moderated. The Beta group is monitored by the Groups.io team.

Reporting bugs

If you encounter a bug, post a message on the Beta group and include the #bug hashtag, or send an email message to support@groups.io. Include as much information as possible to help the Groups.io team reproduce the bug and implement a fix. Due to the current volume of support email, we can only answer messages sent from owners of Premium and Enterprise groups at this time.

Reporting documentation suggestions or corrections

If you find an error in the Groups.io Help Center documentation or have a suggestion for improvement, you can join the Docs subgroup of the Groups.io Beta Group and post it there. The Docs subgroup is monitored by the Groups.io team.

                params.forEach(p => lines.push("\tparams.Add(" + quote(p.name) + ", " + quote(p.value) + ")"));
                if (post) lines.push("\treq, err := http.NewRequest(\"POST\", " + quote(url) + ", strings.NewReader(params.Encode()))");
                else lines.push("\tendpoint := " + quote(url), "\tif query := params.Encode(); query != \"\" { endpoint += \"?\" + query }",
                    "\treq, err := http.NewRequest(" + quote(endpoint.method) + ", endpoint, nil)");

                "\tif _, err := io.Copy(file, resp.Body); err != nil { panic(err) }", '\tfmt.Println("Saved archives.zip")');
            else lines.push("\tbody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)", "\tif err != nil { panic(err) }", "\tfmt.Println(string(body))");

        throw new Error("Unknown example language");
    }

    function validateParameters(endpoint, values) {
        const warnings = [];
        const parameters = endpoint.parameters || [];
        parameters.forEach(p => {
            const entries = values.filter(v => v.name === p.name);
            if (p.requirement === "required" && !entries.some(v => v.value !== "")) warnings.push(p.name + " is required.");
            if (entries.length > 1 && !p.multiple) warnings.push(p.name + " is not documented as a repeated field.");
            entries.forEach(v => {
                if (v.value === "") return;
                if (p.type === "integer" && !/^-?\d+$/.test(v.value)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be an integer.");
                if (p.type === "number" && !/^-?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?$/i.test(v.value)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be a number.");
                if (p.type === "boolean" && !["true", "false"].includes(v.value)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be true or false.");
                if (p.enum && !p.enum.includes(v.value)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be one of: " + p.enum.join(", ") + ".");
                if (p.minimum && Number(v.value) < Number(p.minimum)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be at least " + p.minimum + ".");
                if (p.maximum && Number(v.value) > Number(p.maximum)) warnings.push(p.name + " must be at most " + p.maximum + ".");
            });
        });
        const group = parameters.find(p => p.name === "group_id" && p.requirement === "conditional");
        if (group && parameters.some(p => p.name === "group_name") && !values.some(v => ["group_id", "group_name"].includes(v.name) && v.value)) {
            warnings.push("Provide group_id or group_name.");
        }
        return Array.from(new Set(warnings));
    }

    function matchesSearch(text, query) {
        const haystack = text.toLocaleLowerCase();
        return query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase().split(/\s+/).every(term => haystack.includes(term));
    }

    if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) module.exports = {generateCode, validateParameters, matchesSearch};
    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const root = document.querySelector(".api-reference");
        if (!root) return;
        const states = new Map();
        let language = "curl";
        try {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem("groupsio.api.language");
            if (languages[saved]) language = saved;
        } catch (_) { /* Storage may be disabled. */ }

        function setLanguage(selected) {
            if (!languages[selected]) return;
            language = selected;
            root.querySelectorAll(".api-language").forEach(select => { select.value = language; });
            root.querySelectorAll(".selected-language").forEach(label => { label.textContent = languages[language]; });
            root.querySelectorAll(".example-code").forEach(code => { code.style.display = code.classList.contains(language + "-example") ? "block" : "none"; });
            try { localStorage.setItem("groupsio.api.language", language); } catch (_) { /* Optional preference. */ }
        }

        function refresh(state) {
            const warnings = state.article.querySelector(".api-builder-warnings");
            warnings.replaceChildren();
            validateParameters(state.endpoint, state.values).forEach(message => {
                const item = document.createElement("li");
                item.textContent = message;
                warnings.append(item);
            });
            Object.keys(languages).forEach(lang => {
                const pre = state.article.querySelector("." + lang + "-example pre");
                if (!pre) return;
                pre.textContent = generateCode(state.endpoint, state.values, lang);
                pre.classList.remove("prettyprint", "prettyprinted", "linenums");
            });
        }

        function collect(state) {
            const values = [];
            state.article.querySelectorAll(".api-builder-field").forEach(field => {
                if (!field.querySelector("input[type=checkbox]").checked) return;
                const customName = field.querySelector(".api-custom-name");
                const name = customName ? customName.value.trim() : field.dataset.name;
                if (!name) return;
                field.querySelectorAll(".api-value").forEach(input => { values.push({name, value: input.value}); });
            });
            state.values = values;
            refresh(state);
        }

        function addField(state, parameter, custom) {
            const field = document.createElement("div");
            field.className = "api-builder-field";
            field.dataset.name = parameter.name;
            const label = document.createElement("label");
            const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
            checkbox.type = "checkbox";
            const existing = state.values.filter(v => v.name === parameter.name);
            checkbox.checked = custom || existing.length > 0;
            label.append(checkbox, document.createTextNode(parameter.name || "Additional parameter"));
            if (parameter.requirement) label.append(document.createTextNode(" · " + parameter.requirement));
            field.append(label);
            if (custom) {
                const name = document.createElement("input");
                name.className = "form-control api-custom-name";
                name.placeholder = "Parameter name";
                name.value = parameter.name;
                name.setAttribute("aria-label", "Additional parameter name");
                field.append(name);
            }
            const help = document.createElement("p");
            help.className = "api-builder-help";
            help.textContent = parameter.type || "";
            if (parameter.multiple) help.textContent += " · Repeat the same field name";
            if (parameter.default !== undefined) help.textContent += " · Default: " + parameter.default;
            field.append(help);
            if (parameter.description) {
                const description = document.createElement("p");
                description.className = "api-builder-help";
                description.textContent = parameter.description.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, "$1").replace(/`/g, "");
                field.append(description);
            }
            const inputs = document.createElement("div");
            field.append(inputs);
            function addValue(value) {
                const row = document.createElement("div");
                row.className = "api-value-row";
                let input;
                const options = parameter.type === "boolean" ? ["", "true", "false"] : parameter.enum;
                if (options && options.length && (!value || options.includes(value))) {
                    input = document.createElement("select");
                    Array.from(new Set([""].concat(options))).forEach(option => {
                        const el = document.createElement("option");
                        el.value = option; el.textContent = option || "(empty value)";
                        input.append(el);
                    });
                } else {
                    input = document.createElement("textarea");
                    input.rows = value.includes("\n") ? 3 : 1;
                    input.spellcheck = false;
                }
                input.className = "form-control api-value";
                input.setAttribute("aria-label", (parameter.name || "Additional parameter") + " value");
                input.value = value;
                input.disabled = !checkbox.checked;
                if (parameter.type === "multipart file") input.placeholder = "/path/to/file";
                row.append(input);
                if (parameter.multiple || custom) {
                    const remove = document.createElement("button");
                    remove.type = "button";
                    remove.className = "btn btn-default btn-xs";
                    remove.textContent = "Remove";
                    remove.addEventListener("click", () => { row.remove(); collect(state); });
                    row.append(remove);
                }
                inputs.append(row);
            }
            (existing.length ? existing : [{value: ""}]).forEach(v => addValue(v.value));
            if (parameter.multiple || custom) {
                const add = document.createElement("button");
                add.type = "button";
                add.className = "btn btn-default btn-xs";
                add.textContent = "Add value";
                add.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    checkbox.checked = true;
                    addValue("");
                    inputs.querySelectorAll(".api-value").forEach(el => { el.disabled = false; });
                    collect(state);
                });
                field.append(add);
            }
            checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
                inputs.querySelectorAll(".api-value").forEach(input => { input.disabled = !checkbox.checked; });
                collect(state);
            });
            field.addEventListener("input", () => collect(state));
            field.addEventListener("change", event => { if (event.target !== checkbox) collect(state); });
            state.article.querySelector(".api-builder-fields").append(field);
        }

        function buildEditor(state) {
            const container = state.article.querySelector(".api-builder-fields");
            container.replaceChildren();
            state.endpoint.parameters.forEach(p => {
                if (!(state.endpoint.authenticated && p.name === "csrf")) addField(state, p, false);
            });
            const names = new Set(state.endpoint.parameters.map(p => p.name));
            state.values.forEach(v => {
                if (!names.has(v.name)) {
                    names.add(v.name);
                    addField(state, {name: v.name, multiple: true}, true);
                }
            });
            state.built = true;
        }

        root.querySelectorAll(".api-operation").forEach(article => {
            const metadata = article.querySelector(".api-metadata");
            if (!metadata) return;
            const endpoint = JSON.parse(metadata.textContent);
            endpoint.parameters = endpoint.parameters || [];
            const state = {article, endpoint, values: [], built: false};
            states.set(article, state);
            const select = article.querySelector(".api-scenario");
            function chooseExample() {
                const example = endpoint.examples[Number(select.value)];
                state.values = (example.values || []).map(v => ({...v}));
                article.querySelector(".api-scenario-description").textContent = example.description || "";
                if (state.built) buildEditor(state);
                refresh(state);
            }
            select.addEventListener("change", chooseExample);
            article.querySelector(".api-builder").addEventListener("toggle", event => {
                if (event.target.open && !state.built) buildEditor(state);
            });
            article.querySelector(".api-add-field").addEventListener("click", () => { addField(state, {name: "", multiple: true}, true); });
            chooseExample();
        });
        setLanguage(language);
        root.querySelectorAll(".api-language").forEach(select => select.addEventListener("change", () => setLanguage(select.value)));
        root.addEventListener("click", async event => {
            const languageLink = event.target.closest("[data-language]");
            if (languageLink) { event.preventDefault(); setLanguage(languageLink.dataset.language); return; }
            const copy = event.target.closest(".copy-button, .api-copy-path");
            if (!copy) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            let text = copy.dataset.path;
            if (text === undefined) {
                const article = copy.closest(".api-operation");
                const pre = article && article.querySelector("." + language + "-example pre");
                if (!pre) return;
                const numbered = pre.querySelectorAll("li");
                text = numbered.length ? Array.from(numbered, line => line.textContent).join("\n") : pre.textContent;
            }
            const status = root.querySelector(".api-copy-status");
            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
                status.textContent = "Copied to clipboard.";
                const icon = copy.querySelector("i");
                if (icon) icon.className = "fa-solid fa-check";
                else copy.textContent = "Copied";
                window.setTimeout(() => {
                    if (icon) icon.className = "fa-regular fa-clipboard-list";
                    else copy.textContent = "Copy path";
                }, 1500);
            } catch (_) {
                status.textContent = "Copy is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.";
            }
        });

        const search = root.querySelector("#api-search");
        function highlightAnchor() {
            root.querySelectorAll(".api-nav a").forEach(link => {
                if (link.getAttribute("href") === window.location.hash) link.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
                else link.removeAttribute("aria-current");
            });
        }
        window.addEventListener("hashchange", highlightAnchor);
        highlightAnchor();
        const entries = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".api-nav-entry")).map(entry => {
            const article = document.getElementById(entry.dataset.target);
            const state = states.get(article);
            // Code samples mention many unrelated terms such as status/error;
            // index the actual API description and parameters instead.
            const text = state ? [entry.textContent, state.endpoint.path, state.endpoint.permissions,
                ...state.endpoint.parameters.map(p => p.name + " " + p.description),
                article.querySelector(".api-columns > div").textContent].join(" ") : (article ? article.textContent : entry.textContent);
            return {entry, text};
        });
        search.addEventListener("input", () => {
            let count = 0;
            entries.forEach(({entry, text}) => { entry.hidden = !matchesSearch(text, search.value); if (!entry.hidden) count++; });
            root.querySelectorAll(".api-nav-section").forEach(section => {
                section.hidden = !Array.from(section.querySelectorAll(".api-nav-entry")).some(entry => !entry.hidden);
            });
            root.querySelector(".api-search-count").textContent = search.value.trim() ? count + " matching sections" : "";
        });
        search.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") { search.value = ""; search.dispatchEvent(new Event("input")); }
            if (event.key === "Enter") {
                const first = entries.find(({entry}) => !entry.hidden);
                if (first) first.entry.querySelector("a").click();
            }
        });
    });
})();

	// Short fade-in on #maincontent-refresh after every HTMX swap — adds zero latency
	// because it runs AFTER the new content has arrived. We listen to afterRequest
	// (fires once per HTMX request) rather than afterSwap (fires once per swapped
	// element, including every hx-swap-oob badge — which would cancel the animation).
	// Listen on document because this script runs in <head> before <body> exists.
	document.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function(evt) {
		if (!evt.detail || !evt.detail.successful) return;
		var refresh = document.getElementById('maincontent-refresh');
		if (!refresh) return;
		refresh.classList.remove('gio-fade-in');
		// force reflow so removing then adding re-starts the animation each time
		void refresh.offsetWidth;
		refresh.classList.add('gio-fade-in');
	});

	// Top-of-viewport progress bar shown while an HTMX request is in flight.
	// Provides immediate visual feedback for taps even before content arrives.
	document.addEventListener('htmx:beforeRequest', function() {
		var bar = document.getElementById('gio-progress-bar');
		if (bar) bar.classList.add('active');
	});
	document.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function() {
		var bar = document.getElementById('gio-progress-bar');
		if (bar) bar.classList.remove('active');
	});

	// chevron, and the navbar overflow action slot. Uses the shared helpers
	// from qtutils/appfunctions.qtpl — they no-op on non-Capacitor runtimes,

<script>
// Keep track of the currently selected index
var selectedIndex = -1;

// Function to highlight the matched substring
function highlightSubstring(str, substring) {
  var index = str.toLowerCase().indexOf(substring.toLowerCase());
  if (index !== -1) {
    var before = str.substring(0, index);
    var middle = str.substring(index, index + substring.length);
    var after = str.substring(index + substring.length);
    return before + '<span class="autocomplete-highlight">' + middle + '</span>' + after;
  }
  return str;
}

// Function to highlight the selected item and ensure it is visible in the scrollable list
function highlightSelectedItem(modalName) {
  var listContainer = document.getElementById(modalName + 'Container');
  var items = document.getElementsByClassName(modalName + '-list-item');
  Array.from(items).forEach(function(item, idx) {
    item.className = idx === selectedIndex ? modalName + '-list-item autocomplete-list-item btn-primary no-hover' : modalName + '-list-item autocomplete-list-item no-hover'; // Apply btn-primary class to the selected item
  });
  if (items.length > 0 && selectedIndex >= 0) {
    var selectedItem = items[selectedIndex];
    var containerTop = listContainer.scrollTop;
    var containerBottom = containerTop + listContainer.clientHeight;
    var itemTop = selectedItem.offsetTop;
    var itemBottom = itemTop + selectedItem.offsetHeight;
	const fudge = 59;
    if (selectedIndex > 0 && itemTop > containerBottom) {
      // If there are items below the selected item and the selected item is not fully visible, scroll down
      listContainer.scrollTop = itemTop - listContainer.clientHeight + items[selectedIndex - 1].offsetHeight;
    } else if (selectedIndex < items.length - 1 && (itemTop - fudge) < containerTop) {
      // If there are items above the selected item and the selected item is not fully visible, scroll up
      listContainer.scrollTop = itemTop - fudge - items[selectedIndex + 1].offsetHeight;
    }
  }
}

// function to populate the list based on the input
function populateList(modalName, data) {
  var input = document.getElementById(modalName+'Input').value;
  var listContainer = document.getElementById(modalName+'Container');
  listContainer.innerHTML = '';
  data.forEach(function(item) {
    if (item.name.toLowerCase().includes(input.toLowerCase())) {
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.innerHTML = highlightSubstring(item.name, input);
      div.className = modalName+'-list-item autocomplete-list-item no-hover'; // Apply no-hover class
      div.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Navigate to the specified URL when a list item is clicked
        window.location.href = item.url;
      });
      div.addEventListener('mousemove', function() {
        // Remove no-hover class from all items when the mouse is moved over any item
		console.log("mouse move");
        var items = document.getElementsByClassName(modalName+'-list-item');
        Array.from(items).forEach(function(item) {
          item.classList.remove('no-hover');
        });
      });
      listContainer.appendChild(div);
    }
  });
  highlightSelectedItem(modalName);
}

function InitAutocomplete(modalName, data) {
	// Focus the input field when the modal is shown and populate the list
	$('#' + modalName + 'Modal').on('shown.bs.modal', function () {
		$('#' + modalName + 'Input').focus().val('');
		populateList(modalName, data);
		selectedIndex = 0;
		highlightSelectedItem(modalName);
	});

	// Event listener for input field typing
	document.getElementById(modalName + 'Input').addEventListener('input', function() {
		populateList(modalName, data);
		selectedIndex = 0;
	});

	// Event listener for arrow keys and enter key
	document.getElementById(modalName + 'Input').addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
		var items = document.getElementsByClassName(modalName + '-list-item');
		if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
			event.preventDefault();
			if (selectedIndex < items.length - 1) selectedIndex++;
			highlightSelectedItem(modalName);
		} else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
			event.preventDefault();
			if (selectedIndex > 0) selectedIndex--;
			highlightSelectedItem(modalName);
		} else if (event.key === 'Enter' && selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < items.length) {
			event.preventDefault();
			items[selectedIndex].click();
		}
	});
}

function showAutocompleteModal(modalName) {
	$('#' + modalName + 'Modal').modal('show');
	selectedIndex = -1;
}
</script>

	// --- Native date/time picker helpers -----------------------------------
	// On touch devices we swap flatpickr-wrapped <input type="text"> fields
	// for native <input type="date"> / type="time" so iOS / Android bring up
	// their OS pickers (wheel, spinner, Material dialog). On pointer
	// devices we leave the flatpickr popover in place, since Chrome's
	// default date popover looks out of place. Both helpers are global so
	// every page with a date/time input can call them the same way.
	window.__isTouchPicker = function() {
		return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(any-pointer: coarse)').matches;
	};
	// Fallback formats if data.User is nil on this page (logged out, etc).
	window.__userDateFmt = "M/D/YYYY";
	window.__userTimeFmt = "h:mmA";
	// Hybrid native picker: the field is shown to the user as a plain
	// type=text input holding the date/time formatted per the user's
	// Groups.io preference (e.g., "19/04/2026" for an International
	// user). When the user taps the field, we briefly swap the input's
	// type to 'date' or 'time' so the OS brings up its native picker
	// (iOS wheel, Android calendar/spinner). When the user finishes
	// picking and blurs the field, we swap back to text and reformat
	// the value in the user's chosen format. The server sees the
	// user-format value on submit, same as with flatpickr.
	//
	// `kind` is 'date' or 'time'. `onHumanChange(humanStr, momentObj)`
	// fires whenever the user picks a new value, with the value already
	// in the user's format.
	window.useNativePicker = function(id, kind, onHumanChange) {
		var input = document.getElementById(id);
		if (!input) return null;
		var userFmt = kind === 'time' ? window.__userTimeFmt : window.__userDateFmt;
		var isoFmt = kind === 'time' ? 'HH:mm' : 'YYYY-MM-DD';
		// Page loads with input type=text holding a user-format value —
		// leave it as is until the user actually taps.
		function toPicker() {
			if (input.type !== kind) {
				var m = moment(input.value, userFmt);
				input.type = kind;
				input.value = m.isValid() ? m.format(isoFmt) : '';
			}
		}
		function toDisplay() {
			if (input.type === kind) {
				var m = moment(input.value, isoFmt);
				input.type = 'text';
				input.value = m.isValid() ? m.format(userFmt) : '';
			}
		}
		// pointerdown fires before focus/click so we can swap the type
		// in time for the browser's default tap-handling to open the
		// correct native picker. Fall back to 'focus' for keyboard users.
		input.addEventListener('pointerdown', toPicker);
		input.addEventListener('focus', toPicker);
		input.addEventListener('change', function() {
			if (input.type === kind) {
				var m = moment(input.value, isoFmt);
				if (m.isValid() && onHumanChange) {
					onHumanChange(m.format(userFmt), m);
				}
			}
		});
		input.addEventListener('blur', toDisplay);
		// Make sure the server always sees the user-format value.
		var form = input.closest('form');
		if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', toDisplay);
		return input;
	};
	// Set a field's value as a user-format string, whether the field is a
	// flatpickr-wrapped text input (desktop) or a native type=date/time
	// input (touch). Used by onChange handlers that update sibling fields.
	window.setFieldHuman = function(id, humanStr, kind) {
		var input = document.getElementById(id);
		if (!input) return;
		if (input._flatpickr) {
			input._flatpickr.setDate(humanStr);
		} else if (input.type === 'date' || input.type === 'time') {
			var userFmt = kind === 'time' ? window.__userTimeFmt : window.__userDateFmt;
			var isoFmt = kind === 'time' ? 'HH:mm' : 'YYYY-MM-DD';
			var m = moment(humanStr, userFmt);
			if (m.isValid()) input.value = m.format(isoFmt);
		} else {
			input.value = humanStr;
		}
	};

	var drawerCloseFunc = function(evt) {

	document.body.addEventListener('htmx:beforeSwap', drawerCloseFunc);

	var keydownFunc = function(event) {
		var tagName = event.target.tagName.toLowerCase();
		if (tagName === 'input' || tagName === 'textarea' || event.target.isContentEditable) {
			if (event.key === 'Escape') {
				event.target.blur();
			}
			return;
		}
		// check if the viewimages viewer is up
		let element = document.getElementById('overlay');
		if (element && element.classList.contains('visible')) {
			return;
		}
		console.log("HERE: " + event.key + " " + event.ctrlKey + " " + event.shiftKey + " " + event.metaKey);
		if (event.ctrlKey && event.shiftKey && (event.key === '?' || event.key === '/')) {
			event.preventDefault(); // Prevent the default action
			// Show the modal dialog for keyboard shortcuts
			$('#shortcutModal').modal('show');
			return;
		}
		// Pressing the chord above delivers a keydown for each key in it:
		// Control, then Shift, then '?'. Without this guard the first two fall
		// through to the hide below, so re-pressing the chord while the modal is
		// open starts a hide that the '?' a moment later interrupts with a show.
		// Bootstrap 3 tracks only its most recent backdrop element, so each such
		// overlap strands the previous one in the DOM as an undismissable mask.
		if (event.key === 'Control' || event.key === 'Shift' || event.key === 'Alt' || event.key === 'Meta') {
			return;
		}
		$('#shortcutModal').modal('hide');

		if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'g') {
			// For Windows and Linux
			if (event.ctrlKey) {
				event.preventDefault();
				showAutocompleteModal("groupnavigator");
				return;

		// Check if the pressed key is '/'

			if (navigator.platform.toUpperCase().indexOf('MAC') >= 0) {
				if (event.metaKey) {

					let box = document.getElementById('searchbox')
					if (box != null) {
						document.getElementById('searchbox').focus();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

      <section id="api_reference" class="api-section">
        <h2>API Reference - ALPHA</h2>
        <p>The Groups.io API is organized around <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_State_Transfer" target="_blank">REST</a>. Our API has predictable, resource-oriented URLs, and uses HTTP response codes to indicate API errors. We use built-in HTTP features, like HTTP authentication and HTTP verbs, which are understood by off-the-shelf HTTP clients. <a href="http://www.json.org/" target="_blank">JSON</a> is returned by many API responses, when appropriate, including errors.</p>

<p><em>Note</em>: The API is under active development. Items marked [NI] mean they are not yet implemented.</p>

<p>There is <a href="https://beta.groups.io/g/api" target="_blank">a group</a> to discuss the API. If you have questions about the API or suggestions for improvements of the API or the docs, please
post them there.</p>

<p>AI agents can use the <a href="/api/SKILLS.md">Groups.io API skill guide</a> for authentication, pagination, safety, and endpoint usage guidance.</p>
<h4>API Endpoints</h4>

<p>Use <code>https://groups.io</code> as the default origin and <code>/api/v1/</code> as the API path prefix. For example, <code>GET https://groups.io/api/v1/getsubs</code> lists your subscriptions. To scope requests to an enterprise site, use its domain as the origin. This page, <code>/api</code>, is the reference documentation.</p>

            <h3>Versioning And Change Log<a class="api-permalink" href="#versioning_and_change_log" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p><em>NOTE</em> During development, we sometimes need to make backwards incompatible changes. If this happens during development, we will not be changing API versions.</p>

<p>View the <a href="/apichangelog">changelog</a> to see changes between different versions.</p>
<h4>What changes does Groups.io consider to be “backwards-compatible”?</h4>

<ul>
<li>Adding new API resources.</li>
<li>Adding new optional request parameters to existing API methods.</li>
<li>Adding new properties to existing API responses.</li>
<li>Changing the order of properties in existing API responses.</li>
<li>Changing the length of object IDs or other opaque strings.</li>
<li>You can safely assume object IDs we generate will never exceed 255 characters, but you should be able to handle IDs of up to that length. If for example you’re using MySQL, you should store IDs in a VARCHAR(255) COLLATE utf8_bin column (the COLLATE configuration ensures case-sensitivity in lookups). Adding new event types.</li>
</ul>

</div>

            <div class="api-columns">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>Groups.io uses conventional HTTP response codes to indicate the success or failure of an API request. HTTP response code 200 indicates success and HTTP response code 400 indicates an error. In addition, some endpoints need to return additional information on success. In these instances, a success object is returned with the additional information. This object is returned with the HTTP 200 response code.</p>

</div>

          <article id="errors" class="api-operation">
            <h3>Errors<a class="api-permalink" href="#errors" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="api-columns">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>Groups.io uses conventional HTTP response codes to indicate the success or failure of an API request. HTTP response code 200 indicates success and HTTP response code 400 indicates an error. In addition, when there is an error, an error object is returned, containing details of the error.</p>

<p>Most API errors return HTTP 400 with an error object. HTTP 429 responses have no error object; unknown endpoints return HTTP 404 with a plain-text body. Check the HTTP status before decoding the response. Errors specific to API calls are listed
with each API call. General errors, that can happen with any API call, are listed in this section.</p>

</div>

      <section id="authentication" class="api-section">
        <h2>Authentication</h2>
        
        <div class="">

          <article id="authentication_methods" class="api-operation">
            <h3>Authentication Methods<a class="api-permalink" href="#authentication_methods" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>Authentication to the API is performed via one of three methods:</p>
<h4>API Keys (Recommended)</h4>

<p>The recommended method is to use API keys with the Authorization header, similar to Stripe and OpenAI:</p>
<pre class="prettyprint"><code class="language-bash">curl "https://groups.io/api/v1/getsubs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
</code></pre>
<p>API keys can be created and managed in your account settings at <a href="https://groups.io/settings/apikeys" target="_blank">https://groups.io/settings/apikeys</a>. API keys:</p>

<ul>
<li>Do not require calling <code>/login</code> first</li>
<li>Are stateless - each request is authenticated independently</li>
<li>Bypass two-factor authentication requirements</li>
<li>Do not require CSRF tokens</li>
<li>Can be revoked without changing your password</li>
</ul>

<p>Apple login is currently unavailable.</p>
<h4>Session-Based Authentication</h4>

<p>Alternatively, authentication can be performed via HTTP cookies using cookies set from the <code>login</code> API call, which is the default, or via <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication" target="_blank">HTTP Basic Auth</a>, using a token received from the <code>login</code> API call when passing in the <code>token</code> parameter. The Facebook and Google login flows set authentication cookies. Interactive chat connections require cookie authentication. Generated examples for authenticated HTTP endpoints use Bearer API keys.</p>

<p>All API requests must be made over <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP_Secure" target="_blank">HTTPS</a>. Calls made over plain HTTP will fail.</p>

</div>

                
              </div>
              <div class="api-examples">
                
                
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        
          <article id="request_encoding_and_responses" class="api-operation">
            <h3>Request Encoding And Responses<a class="api-permalink" href="#request_encoding_and_responses" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>Send GET parameters in the query string. Send POST parameters as <code>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code>, except file uploads, which use <code>multipart/form-data</code>. JSON request bodies are not supported unless an endpoint explicitly says otherwise. An <code>Accept: application/json</code> header does not make the request body JSON.</p>

<p>Pass raw values to a URL or form encoder. Do not encode them beforehand. For cURL use <code>--data-urlencode</code> (with <code>--get</code> for GET requests). For multipart uploads use <code>--form</code> for files and <code>--form-string</code> for text fields.</p>

<p>For parameters marked multiple, repeat the same field name: <code>answer=Yes&answer=No</code>. Do not append <code>[]</code> or numeric indexes to the name. In Go use <code>url.Values.Add</code>; in JavaScript use <code>URLSearchParams.append</code> or <code>FormData.append</code>.</p>

<p>Parameters marked conditional explain when they are required. For group identifiers, provide one of <code>group_id</code> or <code>group_name</code> unless the endpoint explicitly allows both to be omitted. Send booleans as <code>true</code> or <code>false</code>. Check the update endpoint's omission rules before leaving out fields; event updates, in particular, replace settings rather than preserving omitted values.</p>

<p>Check the HTTP status before decoding a response. Successful responses may be JSON, an empty body, or a ZIP download, as specified by the endpoint. Handle HTTP 429 with exponential backoff. Do not automatically retry a write whose outcome is unknown.</p>
<h4>Cookie and token login</h4>

<p>API keys do not require login or a CSRF parameter. To use cookies instead, save the cookies returned by <code>POST /api/v1/login</code> and send them on subsequent calls. Cookie-authenticated writes also require the login response's <code>user.csrf_token</code>, sent as the <code>csrf</code> form parameter.</p>
<pre class="prettyprint"><code class="language-bash">curl 'https://groups.io/api/v1/login' --cookie-jar cookies.txt \
  --data-urlencode 'email=you@example.com' \
  --data-urlencode 'password=YOUR_PASSWORD'
curl 'https://groups.io/api/v1/getsubs' --cookie cookies.txt
</code></pre>
<p>For HTTP Basic authentication, call <code>/api/v1/login</code> with <code>token=true</code>, then use the returned <code>token</code> as the Basic username with an empty password (<code>curl --user 'TOKEN:'</code>). This authentication method does not require <code>csrf</code>.</p>

</div>

      <section id="drafts" class="api-section">
        <h2>Drafts</h2>
        <p>A draft represents a post as it is being written. The sequence to post a message to a group is as follows:</p>

<ol>
<li>Create a new draft with <a href="#new_draft">/newdraft</a>.</li>
<li>Compose the message, periodically saving it with <a href="#update_draft">/updatedraft</a>.</li>
<li>Optionally add attachments, using <a href="#upload_attachments">/uploadattachments</a>.</li>
<li>Once complete, send the draft as a message with <a href="#post_draft">/postdraft</a>.</li>
</ol>

<p>There are also several draft maintenance endpoints.</p>

        }
        _, err = io.Copy(part, file)
        file.Close()
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
    }
    if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/uploadattachments", &requestBody)
    if err != nil {

    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())

      <section id="events" class="api-section">
        <h2>Events</h2>
        <p>With RSVPs, here is the flow:</p>

<ul>
<li>When viewing an event, if the <code>rsvp</code> field of the Event object is true, an RSVP is requested.</li>
<li>If the <code>comment_label</code> field in the Event is not empty, display a text field for entry of a comment.</li>
<li>If the <code>additional_guests</code> field of the Event object is true, display a drop down to select the number of additional guests.</li>
<li>If the <code>has_rsvp</code> field of the Event object is false, display three buttons: Will Attend, Will Not Attend, Not Sure.</li>
<li>If the <code>has_rsvp</code> field of the Event object is true, the <code>rsvp_type</code>, <code>rsvp_comment</code> and <code>rsvp_additional_guests</code> fields represent the previous RSVP response.</li>
<li>If the <code>rsvp_type</code> is <code>rsvp_waitlist</code>, that means the person is waitlisted. In this case, the Will Attend button should be 'Update Waitlisted'. This button should return a response value of <code>rsvp_yes</code>, <em>not</em> <code>rsvp_waitlist</code>.</li>
<li>On successfully calling the /v1/rsvp endpoint, an <code>rsvp</code> object is returned. If the <code>type</code> field is set to <code>rsvp_waitlist</code>, that means the user has been waitlisted, and a message should be shown to them announcing that.</li>
</ul>

<p>Event Reminders:</p>

<p>Event reminders are notifications sent before an event starts. They support various time intervals and can be sent as regular or special notices.</p>

<p>Setting Reminders:</p>

<ul>
<li>Reminders are specified using three parallel arrays: reminder_interval, reminder_type, and reminder_special</li>
<li>reminder_interval: The numeric amount (e.g., 15 for 15 minutes, 2 for 2 days)</li>
<li>reminder_type: The unit of time as a form value: "reminder_type_minutes", "reminder_type_hours", "reminder_type_days", "reminder_type_weeks"</li>
<li>reminder_special: "true" for a special notice, "false" for a regular notice. Supply a value for every reminder when mixing regular and special notices, to keep their positions aligned.</li>
</ul>

<p>Examples:</p>

<ul>
<li>15 minutes before: reminder_interval=15&reminder_type=reminder_type_minutes&reminder_special=false</li>
<li>1 hour before: reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_hours&reminder_special=false</li>
<li>2 days before: reminder_interval=2&reminder_type=reminder_type_days&reminder_special=false</li>
<li>1 week before: reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_weeks&reminder_special=false</li>
</ul>

<p>Multiple Reminders:
You can set multiple reminders by repeating each field name in the same order:</p>

<ul>
<li>reminder_interval=15&reminder_type=reminder_type_minutes&reminder_special=false (15 minutes)</li>
<li>reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_hours&reminder_special=false (1 hour)</li>
<li>reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_days&reminder_special=true (1 day, special notice)</li>
</ul>

<p>For Recurring Events:</p>

<ul>
<li>Reminders apply to all occurrences in the series</li>
<li>When a series is updated, reminders are recalculated for all future events</li>
<li>Individual occurrences can have different reminders if they are overridden (detached)</li>
</ul>

<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>Update a repeating event series. This call replaces the editable series settings; it is not a partial update. Resubmit text, numeric, boolean, recurrence and reminder values you want to preserve. Omitted text fields are cleared, omitted booleans become false, and omitted numeric settings use their defaults. Color is preserved when omitted. Omitting reminders removes all reminders.</p>

  <strong>Updating Reminders for Repeating Events</strong>
  <p>When updating reminders for a series, the new reminders apply to all future occurrences:</p>

<ul>
<li>reminder_interval=15&reminder_type=reminder_type_minutes&reminder_special=false (15 minutes before each occurrence)</li>
<li>reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_hours&reminder_special=false (1 hour before each occurrence)</li>
<li>Reminders are automatically recalculated for all instances in the series</li>
<li>To remove all reminders, omit the reminder parameters entirely</li>
</ul>

</div>

<div class="api-part">

  <strong>Splitting Series with Different Reminders</strong>
  <p>When splitting a series, you can set different reminders for the new series:</p>

<ul>
<li>The original series keeps its existing reminders up to the split point</li>
<li>The new series uses the reminders specified in the request</li>
<li>Example: Split a daily meeting to change from 15-minute reminders to 1-hour reminders

<ul>
<li>reminder_interval=1&reminder_type=reminder_type_hours&reminder_special=false (1 hour before each future occurrence)</li>
</ul></li>
</ul>

</div>

  <p>Returns the created repeat event. Returns <a href="#errors">an error</a> if parameters are invalid.</p>

<pre class="prettyprint linenums lang-go" style="width:100%">package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "mime/multipart"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
)

func main() {
    var requestBody bytes.Buffer
    writer := multipart.NewWriter(&requestBody)
    if err := writer.WriteField("group_id", "12"); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    if err := writer.WriteField("parent_folder_id", "0"); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    {
        file, err := os.Open("/path/to/document.pdf")
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        part, err := writer.CreateFormFile("fileupload", filepath.Base(file.Name()))
        if err != nil {
            file.Close()
            panic(err)
        }
        _, err = io.Copy(part, file)
        file.Close()
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
    }
    if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/addfiles", &requestBody)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}
</pre>

<pre class="prettyprint linenums lang-js" style="width:100%">// Node.js 18+ (fetch is built in).
async function callAPI() {
    const { readFile } = await import('node:fs/promises');
    const url = new URL("https://groups.io/api/v1/addfiles");
    const body = new FormData();
    body.append("group_id", "12");
    body.append("parent_folder_id", "0");
    body.append("fileupload", new Blob([await readFile("/path/to/document.pdf")]), "document.pdf");

    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" },
        body
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
    }
    const text = await response.text();
    const data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
    console.log(data ?? 'Success (empty response)');
}

callAPI().catch(console.error);</pre>

import (

    params.Add("group_name", "apisubgroup")

    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/creategroup", strings.NewReader(params.Encode()))
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

async function callAPI() {

}

  <ul>
<li>A stand alone/parent group cannot have all the fields <code>announce</code>, <code>restricted</code>, <code>moderated</code>, and <code>new_users_moderated</code> all set to false. If you do this, <code>new_users_moderated</code> will automatically be set to true.</li>
<li>A stand alone/parent group with private archives cannot later be switched to having public archives.</li>
<li>A subgroup with archives that are private to the subgroup cannot be later switched to either public archives or to archives that are viewable by the parent group.</li>
<li>If <code>disable_no_email</code> is changed to true, any member subscriptions that were set to <code>email_delivery_none</code> will automatically be changed to <code>email_delivery_special</code>. <li>If <code>force_html_emails</code> is changed to true, any member subscriptions that were set to <code>email_delivery_digest</code> will automatically be changed to <code>email_delivery_html_digest</code>. <li>If a group has <code>alias</code> set, that field cannot be unset/set to blank.</li>
<li>If this is a subgroup, the <code>name</code> field has to be of the form ParentGroupName+SubGroupName.</li>
<li>A group that is not restricted cannot have a <code>members_visible</code> value of <code>group_view_members_subs</code>, unless it is a subgroup and the parent group is restricted.</li>
</ul>

}

import (

func main() {
    params := url.Values{}
    params.Add("group_id", "1")
    params.Add("member_info_id", "2")
    params.Add("post_status", "sub_poststatus_normal")
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/updatemember", strings.NewReader(params.Encode()))
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

async function callAPI() {
    const url = new URL("https://groups.io/api/v1/updatemember");
    const body = new URLSearchParams();
    body.append("group_id", "1");
    body.append("member_info_id", "2");
    body.append("post_status", "sub_poststatus_normal");

    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" },
        body
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
    }
    const text = await response.text();
    const data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
    console.log(data ?? 'Success (empty response)');
}

<pre class="prettyprint linenums lang-go" style="width:100%">package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "mime/multipart"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
)

func main() {
    var requestBody bytes.Buffer
    writer := multipart.NewWriter(&requestBody)
    if err := writer.WriteField("album_id", "12"); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    {
        file, err := os.Open("/path/to/photo.jpg")
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        part, err := writer.CreateFormFile("fileupload", filepath.Base(file.Name()))
        if err != nil {
            file.Close()
            panic(err)
        }
        _, err = io.Copy(part, file)
        file.Close()
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
    }
    if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/addphotos", &requestBody)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

import (
    "bytes"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "mime/multipart"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
)

func main() {
    var requestBody bytes.Buffer
    writer := multipart.NewWriter(&requestBody)
    {
        file, err := os.Open("/path/to/profile.jpg")
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        part, err := writer.CreateFormFile("imageupload", filepath.Base(file.Name()))
        if err != nil {
            file.Close()
            panic(err)
        }
        _, err = io.Copy(part, file)
        file.Close()
        if err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
    }
    if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/updateprofilephoto", &requestBody)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

import (

func main() {
    params := url.Values{}
    endpoint := "https://groups.io/api/v1/updatesub"
    if query := params.Encode(); query != "" {
        endpoint += "?" + query
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", endpoint, nil)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

      <section id="webhooks" class="api-section">
        <h2>Webhooks</h2>
        <p>Webhooks allow you to be notified whenever a change occurs to a group that you are an owner of. The groups.io service will send a <a href="#the_webhook_event_object">webhook event</a>
object to a URL that you specify whenever an event you are interested in occurs.</p>

<p>Deliveries are HTTP POSTs with a <code>User-Agent</code> of <code>Groups.io/Webhook</code> and an <code>X-Groupsio-Action</code> header naming the action. If your subscription has a <code>secret</code>,
deliveries also include an <code>X-Groupsio-Signature</code> header containing a hex HMAC-SHA256 digest of the request body, keyed with the secret.</p>

<p>Respond with a 2xx status code to acknowledge receipt of an event. Any other status code, or a connection failure, causes the delivery to be retried on a
backoff schedule for up to approximately 45 hours, after which the event is dropped.</p>

<p>Webhook URLs must use http or https and must resolve to a public IP address.</p>

import (
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "net/url"

func main() {
    params := url.Values{}
    params.Add("group_id", "12")
    params.Add("title", "Test")
    params.Add("body", "testing")
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://groups.io/api/v1/newwikipage", strings.NewReader(params.Encode()))
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}

import (
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "net/url"
)

func main() {
    params := url.Values{}
    params.Add("group_id", "12")
    params.Add("q", "find this")
    endpoint := "https://groups.io/api/v1/searchwikis"
    if query := params.Encode(); query != "" {
        endpoint += "?" + query
    }
    req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", endpoint, nil)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY")

    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, body))
    }
    body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(string(body))
}
</pre>

}

            <h3>The Webhook Event Object<a class="api-permalink" href="#the_webhook_event_object" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="api-columns">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>The webhook event object. This represents an action monitored by a <code>webhook_subscription</code>.</p>

</div>

                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  <strong>Response Attributes</strong>
  
<table class="table table-striped table-condensed api-parameter-table"><tbody>

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">id</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>Unique ID for this webhook event.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">object</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>Type of object. Is set to <code>webhook_event</code>.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">created</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  <span>date-time</span>
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The time this event happened.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">webhook_id</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The ID of the webhook_subscription that triggered this event.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">action</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>What action took place. Can be one of: <code>joined</code>, <code>created_subgroup</code>, <code>deleted_subgroup</code>.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">via</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>Through what means the action took place. Can be one of: <code>via_api</code>, <code>via_app</code>, <code>via_email</code>, <code>via_robot</code>, <code>via_slacksync</code>, <code>via_support</code>, <code>via_web</code>.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">group</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span><a href="#the_group_object">Group object</a></span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The group related to the action.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">member_info</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span><a href="#the_member_info_object">Member Info object</a></span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The member who did the action. May be omitted.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">modded_member_info</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span><a href="#the_member_info_object">Member Info object</a></span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events on members, this is the member acted upon. May be omitted.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">non_member_email</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events involving a non-member, this is their email address.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">msg_num</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that involve a message, this is the message number.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">subject</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that involve a message, this is the subject of the message.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">message</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that involve a message, specifically <code>edited_message</code>, <code>sent_message_accepted</code>, <code>sent_message_moderated</code>, this is the raw message.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">extra</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that require an extra string.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">extra2</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that require a second extra string.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">extra_id</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that require an identifier.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">extended_data</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  <span class="label label-info">optional</span>
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>For events that require extended data, in JSON format.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

</tbody></table>

          <article id="the_webhook_subscription_object" class="api-operation">
            <h3>The Webhook Subscription Object<a class="api-permalink" href="#the_webhook_subscription_object" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h3>
            
            <div class="api-columns">
              <div>
                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  
  <p>The webhook subscription object.</p>

</div>

                
                  
<div class="api-part">

  <strong>Response Attributes</strong>
  
<table class="table table-striped table-condensed api-parameter-table"><tbody>

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">id</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>Unique ID of the webhook subscription.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">object</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>Type of object. Is set to <code>webhook_subscription</code>.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">created</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  <span>date-time</span>
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The time this subscription was created.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">updated</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  <span>date-time</span>
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The last time this subscription was updated.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">url</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The URL we are to POST <code>webhook_event</code> objects to.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">secret</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>string</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>If specified, <code>webhook_events</code> will include a X-Groupsio-Signature header, which is an HMAC hex digest using the sha256 hash function and the <code>secret</code> as the HMAC key.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">group_id</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>integer</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The group monitored by this subscription.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">include_subgroups</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>boolean</span>
  
  
  
  
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>If monitoring a group, whether to monitor subgroups as well.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

  <tr>
  
    <th scope="row">
      <span class="api-field-name">actions</span>
      
        
<div class="api-field-meta">
  
  <span>array of string</span>
  
  
  
  <span title="The response field may contain JSON null">nullable</span>
</div>

      
    </th>
    <td>
      <p>The list of actions monitored by this subscription. If empty, all actions are monitored.</p>
      
        
        
        
      
    </td>
  
  </tr>
  

</tbody></table>
